async with native_session(workspace, prepare=prepare, size=size, provider=provider) as native:

replacements.new_source:
async with native_session(workspace, prepare=prepare, size=size, provider=provider) as native:
        expected_goal = native.comms.registry.require(native.thread).goal
        view = native.ui.conversation
        await native.ui.until(
            lambda: view.goal_display.snapshot == expected_goal and view.goal_bar.controls.is_mounted,
            why="the owner's current goal and its mounted controls",
        )
        yield native

operations.rationale: ACP session connection does not imply the separate owner-goal observation has arrived or lazy goal controls have mounted. Preserve the actual tests and wait on their existing source and widget owners before yielding the arranged native journey.
